name: last-turn-diff
description: Shows every file Claude changed in the last turn as one diff pane (/turn-diff), with a summary band above the prompt.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane after each turn
autoOpen.description: Opens the Last turn pane when a turn ends with file changes.

shellEdits.title: Show shell edits
shellEdits.description: Also shows files changed by shell commands, scripts or builds, read from git or Plastic SCM status around each turn.

turnHistory.title: Turn history
turnHistory.description: Lists the conversation's turns that changed files in the pane, so an earlier one can be picked and its changes rebuilt from the transcript. Off, the pane shows only the last turn with changes, numbered from when the mod loaded, and the transcript is never read.

hideClaudeFiles.title: Hide Claude's own files
hideClaudeFiles.description: Leaves out Claude Code's own files: its temporary folder (scratchpads, pasted images), claude under CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR or else the system's temporary folder, and its memory and plans, projects, agent-memory and plans under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or else ~/.claude. A session run inside one of those folders still sees its own files.

showMemoryAndPlans.title: Show Claude's memory and plan edits
showMemoryAndPlans.description: With hideClaudeFiles on, still shows Claude's edits to its memory and plans (projects, agent-memory and plans in its config folder); its temporary files stay hidden. Listed only while hideClaudeFiles is on.

svgDiffs.title: Draw diffs as images on Desktop
svgDiffs.description: In the Desktop Code tab, draws each file's diff as an image with red and green lines, line numbers and syntax colors; the text can't be selected, so each hunk has a Copy button. Off, Desktop shows plain diff code blocks. selectableDiffs takes precedence.

selectableDiffs.title: Selectable diffs on Desktop
selectableDiffs.description: In the Desktop Code tab, draws each hunk as numbered code blocks with Desktop's own syntax colors, whose text can be selected: unchanged, removed and added lines in blocks of their own, removed lines marked - in a red frame and added ones marked + in a green frame (a copy takes the marks too). Takes precedence over svgDiffs.
